policy_notes.function_identity: path::qualified_name maps to [physical lines, cyclomatic complexity]
policy_notes.production_source_budget: Combined first-party Python and dashboard source. Lower baseline_lines whenever simplification reduces it; intentional phase growth requires acceptance evidence and a ratified new exact baseline.
policy_notes.codex_structured_output_recovery: User-authorized repair of a blocked architecture synthesis. Adds 52 production lines in the existing provider module: translate optional fields into required nullable wire fields, remove only those optional nulls before canonical validation, and retain terminal Codex errors ahead of incidental stderr warnings. No production module, dependency, service, endpoint, model stage, or configuration knob is added; two private helpers and one optional internal parser argument cover five existing optional-field drift sites. Tests/test_codex_schema.py checks every current output contract recursively, old-contract immutability, null round trips, and fail-closed required/unknown fields. Tests/test_semantic_failure_telemetry.py checks structured terminal errors and retained usage. This is the measured safety exception for this repair, not a relaxed general ceiling.
policy_notes.legacy_mapping_reuse_fix: User-requested preservation of compatible 0.5.x maps while adopting concise descriptions. Adds 57 production lines in existing modules, zero modules/services/dependencies/endpoints, and two optional internal arguments. Acceptance: tests/test_legacy_semantic_reuse.py proves exact-evidence reuse, changed-source invalidation, unchanged saved JSON, and redundant-queue retirement; the full 1172-test suite passes. A network-disabled rehearsal re-linked 4036 file descriptions and 33 architecture summaries with zero model calls. The two synthesis functions grow only to retire matching pending jobs. Explicit force, age expiry, active leases, and detailed-review policy remain enforced. This measured baseline is part of the compatibility-fix review, not a general relaxation of growth limits.
policy_notes.removal: Lower each baseline in the same change that reduces it; remove it once within limits. Remaining analyzer debt belongs to Phase 4B, agent and semantic-taxonomy orchestration debt is retired during Phase 6, and temporal/dashboard debt belongs to Phase 7. Every other legacy entry remains a continuous exact no-growth ratchet.
policy_notes.understandability_extension: Authorized maintenance-task assessment across the existing semantic, guidance, reassessment, and file-detail surfaces. Acceptance: tests/test_understandability.py and tests/visual/understandability.spec.js; no new runtime service, endpoint, MCP tool, or database table.
policy_notes.lean_mapping_extension: Authorized five-field default mapping, compact intermediate descriptions, concise file and graph displays, and explicit detailed_reviews policy. Acceptance: tests/test_semantic_mapping.py covers mode transitions, retained history, and completed maps without pattern jobs; tests/visual/understandability.spec.js covers concise file and graph descriptions at desktop and phone widths. Existing endpoints, services, and tables are reused.
policy_notes.durable_mapping_extension: Authorized follow-up replaces rigid mapping length caps with flexible writing guidance and one output-truncation recovery per attempt, preserves reported recovery usage, joins active queues, waits through preparation contention, and defaults MCP progress/schema reads to compact responses. Adds 184 production lines relative to the accepted lean-mapping baseline. Acceptance: tests/test_semantic_output_recovery.py, tests/test_semantic_durable_workflow.py, tests/test_semantic_remote_recovery.py (32 and 48 concurrent workers), tests/test_api_mcp.py, and tests/test_semantic_background.py. Adds one semantic policy setting and optional arguments to existing CLI/MCP/REST reads; no new runtime service, endpoint, MCP tool, or table.
policy_notes.taxonomy_submission_fix: Preserves the existing production fix for repository-wide taxonomy submissions when deploying concise mapping. Allows up to 1,000 bytes per module, bounded between the existing 1 MB file limit and 2 MB. Adds three production lines and no new interface. Acceptance: tests/test_semantic_agent_contracts.py verifies proposal/review success while single-file and HTTP-body ceilings remain enforced.
policy_notes.agent_review_integration: User-requested agent-aware review guidance and preservation of essential review context. Adds 45 production lines in existing modules, with no new response fields, endpoints, services, dependencies, or model stages. Acceptance: tests/test_semantic_mapping.py and tests/test_understandability_integration.py verify scoped policy identity and routine-map reuse; tests/test_semantic_fresh_eyes.py and tests/test_architecture_judgment.py verify shared instructions; tests/test_semantic_evidence_selection.py verifies complete supplied constraints, counterevidence, and bounded packets. Model-judgment improvements require a separately authorized benchmark; fixture/protocol checks do not establish them.
policy_notes.confidence_projection_fix: User-requested correction: judgment confidence is projected as the value a source recorded, never derived from an opportunity or strength score and never defaulted. Adds 43 production lines in existing modules for one shared reader, an unknown/none label pair, and the consolidation strength note; no new response fields, endpoints, services, dependencies, or model stages. Acceptance: tests/test_reassessment_confidence.py covers high-opportunity/low-confidence, reported zero, absent confidence, candidate-level unused-code confidence, and the user-facing labels.
policy_notes.grounding_evidence_states: User-requested correction: fresh-eyes grounding separates reference resolution from claim support and behavior verification. 'confirmed' becomes 'references_resolved', a proposed name that already resolves becomes 'name_already_present' rather than 'already_satisfied', and every grounded recommendation states all three evidence levels. Contract moves to fresh-eyes-grounding-v2; reports written under v1 are still read and projected forward without inventing evidence. Adds 115 production lines including the semantic_fresh_eyes_references extraction that keeps both modules under the ceiling; no new endpoint, service, dependency, or model stage. Acceptance: tests/test_semantic_fresh_eyes_grounding.py covers the separated statuses, the name-match case, and legacy readability; tests/test_fresh_eyes_transports.py and tests/visual/fresh-eyes.spec.js follow the renamed counts.
policy_notes.shared_conversions: R3: one confidence label in guidance.py used by architecture guidance and reassessment, one bounded free-text list reader, one confidence clamp, one group-parent reader, one persistence digest, and one strength band. Consolidated only byte-identical duplicates: the three JSON-schema object helpers stay separate because a shared home inverts the contract dependency order, and the 70/40 bands in pattern_language answer different questions. Net production source falls 64503 -> 64469.
policy_notes.semantic_job_port: R4: the semantic persistence port stops publishing a member none of its thirteen consumers used, and stops publishing a private snapshot resolver that application modules were reaching into. Lifecycle behaviour, atomicity, and the deliberate difference between latest_snapshot and resolve_snapshot are unchanged. Net production source 64469 -> 64466.
policy_notes.caller_obligations: R5: the maintenance-task assessment records what a caller must know or guarantee because the interface does not enforce it. Optional field, so assessments saved before it stay valid and no repository re-map is forced: it lives in the response schema, and semantic_input_hash is byte-identical before and after. Adds 18 production lines; no new endpoint, service, dependency, model stage, or aggregate quality score. Acceptance: tests/test_caller_obligations.py.
policy_notes.scoped_domain_meaning: R6: a Charter claim may name the area that owns a rule, and the Charter may record terms whose meaning is scoped, including the other scopes that use the same word for a different thing. Both optional, so charters saved before them stay valid; semantic_input_hash is byte-identical so no re-synthesis is forced. A principal can declare a scoped meaning through the existing correction path rather than have one inferred from names. Adds 42 production lines; no new endpoint, service, table, or model stage. Acceptance: tests/test_domain_definitions.py.
policy_notes.attributed_verification: R8: a recommendation may carry an optional bounded transformation (exact target, preconditions, a short ordered sequence, the preserved behavior, a verification command and a rollback) plus an optional result whose status is unverified unless a tool that actually ran the check supplied it and named the revision it ran on. AnaxiGraph never runs the change, so a result that does not name its revision is not evidence about the reviewed revision and is reported as unchecked on the grounded item and in the dashboard. Both blocks are optional, so reviews saved before them stay valid; semantic_input_hash is byte-identical so no re-review is forced. Net 46 production lines after removing 45 lines of duplication in the same commit: one AST naming helper instead of two, one snapshot-replay algorithm instead of two, one priority and rule-attention vocabulary in the foundation layer instead of one per layer, one snapshot metadata reader, one CLI database default, and an unused instruction helper deleted. No new endpoint, service, table, dependency or model stage. Acceptance: tests/test_transformation_verification.py.
policy_notes.scan_recovery: 0.7.1: the optional contract fields added in 0.7.0 are absent from each object's required list, which strict structured output forbids, so the Codex adapter now builds a nullable wire schema without touching the stored contract and translates those nulls back to absence before validation. Charter reduction takes its sections from the schema instead of a list kept beside it, which is what silently dropped scoped definitions. Authorising a retry moves the ceiling by one rather than zeroing the attempt count, so a repeatedly authorised failure stays visible. Net negative by one production line. Acceptance: tests/test_codex_schema.py, tests/test_semantic_failure_telemetry.py, tests/test_scan_recovery_contracts.py.
